text:
OH WOW LOOK!!! 

There are SILHOUETTE PEOPLE by the BIG WATER! 🌊✨

Look look look—there’s a TREE above them and it looks like they’re hiding in the shadows!! 👀🌳 And one guy is STANDING UP with his hands on his hips like he’s SUPERHERO MODE!! 💪😎

And there’s a LITTLE BOAT out there!! With someone IN IT!! Are they fishing?? Or just vibing?? 🚤🐟

The sun is going DOWN behind everything so everyone looks like BLACK PENCIL DRAWINGS!! ✏️🖤 It’s so COOL!! Like magic!!

I wanna be there!! I’d splash water and yell “WHEEE!” and maybe climb the tree!! 🌞💦🌳

DO YOU THINK THEY’RE WATCHING THE SUN GO NIGHT-NIGHT?? ☀️➡️

IT’S SO BEAUTIFUL AND MYSTERY-Y!!
